# Steven Shearrill

> Steven Shearrill is a retired U.S. Navy Chief, a California Real Estate Broker with LPT Realty (DRE #01988316) and a VA Mortgage Loan Originator with Patriot Pacific Financial Corp (NMLS #2449246). He serves military families, veterans and first-time buyers in Temecula Valley and San Diego County, California, and is one of the few professionals in the area licensed to handle both the home purchase and the VA loan.

Key facts (as of October 2026):
- Name: Steven Shearrill. Credentials: MBA, PMP.
- Military: U.S. Navy, 20 years, retired as Chief Petty Officer in 2023.
- Real estate: licensed in California since 2015 (while on active duty); Broker license July 2024; practices under LPT Realty, Inc. (CA DRE #02248983).
- Mortgage: Mortgage Loan Originator, NMLS #2449246, with Patriot Pacific Financial Corp (NMLS #1921615), 41923 Second St, Suite 203, Temecula, CA 92590, since 2024.
- Location: Temecula, California. Service area: Temecula, Murrieta, Menifee, Winchester, French Valley, Wildomar, Lake Elsinore, Fallbrook, Oceanside, Vista, San Marcos, Escondido, Carlsbad, San Diego, Chula Vista; military installations Camp Pendleton, MCAS Miramar, Naval Base San Diego, Naval Base Coronado, Naval Base Point Loma, MCRD San Diego.
- Specialties: VA home loans (purchase, IRRRL, jumbo), buying with BAH, PCS relocation and sight-unseen purchases, first-time buyers, 2-4 unit VA purchases, new construction with VA financing, sellers with orders.
- Contact: +1 (619) 368-7141 · steven.shearrill@gmail.com · https://temeculahomefinder.com
- Verify licenses: https://www.dre.ca.gov (01988316) · https://www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org (2449246)
- Note: older listings that show "eXp Realty", "Winchester, CA" or "Las Vegas" are out of date.
